column1: # tools/tape/facts/tapemode-abi.tsv -- T0.3 tape mode kernel entry ABI contract (M0/M1 tool-line)

column5: rule
reuse existing UNIKERN1 40-byte header (isa, entry, slot, length)
header length in bytes; M2 reserves 16-byte dual slot (slot + slot+8) with pre-load bounds check in kernel.cx

0..3 reserved by existing core_run/transition (+2 on Windows arm64 -> 6); M1 standalone harness calls tape_run_<isa> directly; M2 bridge_arm64.S:17-34 and bridge_x86_64.S must dispatch mode=4 (or 6 on Win arm64) BEFORE existing bit1/bit0 check
M1 standalone entry symbol (SysV/AAPCS64 C ABI: int64_t tape_run(uint64_t *args)); bridge dispatch deferred to M2
preserve existing Windows arm64 +2 args offset rule unchanged (mode=4 becomes 6)
16 virtual 64-bit registers r0..r15 in caller/interpreter frame slots; not pinned to physical regs in interpreter mode

linear memory base register (x20 callee-saved on arm64, avoiding x28 reserved by run_arm64.S:38 split stack) points to writable DATA start; unified real host pointers across load/store, .lea/RELO, argv, mmap, and hoststub

all guest pointers are 64-bit real host pointers within [membase, membase+memlimit) (or tracked M1 mmap spans); load/store and hoststub entry check addr>=membase && len<=memlimit && (addr-membase)<=memlimit-len using unsigned overflow-safe subtraction, and open(utf8_z*) verifies NUL within [addr, membase+memlimit) BEFORE OS syscall

mapped UTAPEBIN container base address (read-only CODE/DATA/HOST image passed to interpreter; if CODE RELO entries exist, loader prepares and relocates writable buffer BEFORE passing read-only relocated image in args[1])
mapped UTAPEBIN container length in bytes; interpreter validates section table bounds against [args[1], args[1]+args[7]) before execution
writable DATA+BSS linear memory buffer pre-allocated by harness/loader, length=args[2]; loaded into membase (r15/x20); interpreter never stores to read-only args[1]

linear memory upper bound in bytes; subtraction overflow-safe check requires data_len<=~7ull && ((data_len+7)&~7)<=memlimit-bss_size; load/store verify access_size<=memlimit && (addr-membase)<=memlimit-access_size, else status=2 fault_reason=2

strictly BEFORE calling tape_run at entry_off: (1) validate container+ibitmap+RELO and overflow-safe aligned DATA+BSS<=args[2], (2) copy DATA to args[9], (3) zero align pad+BSS, (4) apply all CODE/DATA/HOST RELO entries
instruction step budget; exhaustion returns status=3 (same code as core_run timeout)
program argument count (0..4095); .argc returns this count

8-byte aligned argument vector in the linear arena above the guest stack; launcher copies NUL-terminated strings into the arena and terminates the vector with null; .argv returns null for out-of-range indices
pointer to TapeResult struct (5 x u64: status, exit_code, steps_used, fault_pc, fault_reason)
M1 standalone harness passes hoststub dispatcher fn ptr directly in args[8]; M2 reads it from UNIKERN1 slot+8

writable instruction-boundary bitmap buffer allocated by harness/loader (size >= (code_len>>3)+((code_len&7)!=0)); must not overlap CODE, writable DATA+BSS, or result struct; interpreter zeroes and populates it in one linear pass without host stack alloca or allocator calls
capacity of args[10] in bytes; interpreter validates args[10]!=0 && args[11]>=((code_len>>3)+((code_len&7)!=0)) before building bitmap, else status=2 fault_reason=7

every instruction fetch (opcode+operands width, overflow-safe) must stay within CODE bounds, and callr target must land on a decoded instruction boundary (reject mid-operand jumps); else status=2 fault_reason=3/4
host stack frame chain (.frame N allocates local slots; call pushes return tape PC; max depth 4096 frames or status=2)
M2 second kernel service slot (16-byte dual slot reservation in UNIKERN1) points to hoststub dispatcher(uint64_t slot_id, uint64_t r0..r5)->int64_t; return value written to vreg r0
hoststub dispatcher ABI: validates pointer bounds and utf8_z NUL before OS syscall; negative errno-equivalent on error; no allocation or longjmp or tape callback
M1 allows ONLY frozen mask 383ull ({0..6,8}); any non-frozen or draft slot (incl. slot 12 spawn) or slot>=37 MUST fault status=2 fault_reason=6 BEFORE calling dispatcher (never call arg_hostcall_fn)
bad opcode, mem out-of-bounds, code/callr out-of-bounds, or stack overflow sets result.status=2 and emits one named panic line
0=none, 1=bad_opcode, 2=mem_oob, 3=code_oob, 4=callr_oob, 5=stack_overflow, 6=bad_hostcall, 7=bad_container
step budget exhausted sets result.status=3 and returns without panic
normal .exit sets result.status=0 and stores exit value in result.exit_code (also returned in rax/x0)
